mapper.sql: select pn.id, pn.pallet_no, pn.barcode, pn.storage_period, pn.classification, pn.inbound_date, pn.wh_cd, pn.zone_cd, pn.loc_cd, pn.memo1, pn.memo2, pn.printed_flg, pn.delete_flg, pn.create_time, pn.create_by, pn.create_pg_id, pn.update_time, pn.update_by, pn.update_pg_id, pn.version, mw.wh_nm from bss_pallet_number pn left join mast_warehouse mw on mw.wh_cd = pn.wh_cd and mw.delete_flg = '0'

select pnd.id, pnd.pallet_no, pnd.item_code, pnd.item_name, pnd.product_group, pnd.arrangement_no, pnd.storage_qty, pnd.storage_capacity, pnd.storage_type, pnd.usable_flag, pnd.remarks, pnd.delete_flg, pnd.create_time, pnd.create_by, pnd.create_pg_id, pnd.update_time, pnd.update_by, pnd.update_pg_id, pnd.version from bss_pallet_number_detail pnd
mapper.select:
where pn.delete_flg = '0'
and pn.wh_cd = #{whCd}
and pn.loc_cd like concat('%', #{locCd}, '%')
and pn.pallet_no like concat('%', #{palletNo}, '%')
and pn.storage_period like concat('%', #{storagePeriod}, '%')
and pn.classification = #{classification}
and replace(replace(coalesce(pn.inbound_date, ''), '/', ''), '-', '') like concat(replace(replace(#{inboundDate}, '/', ''), '-', ''), '%')
and exists ( select 1 from bss_pallet_number_detail pnd where pnd.pallet_no = pn.pallet_no and pnd.delete_flg = '0' and pnd.item_code like concat('%', #{itemCode}, '%') )
and exists ( select 1 from bss_pallet_number_detail pnd where pnd.pallet_no = pn.pallet_no and pnd.delete_flg = '0' and pnd.item_name like concat('%', #{itemName}, '%') )
order by pn.pallet_no desc
mapper.insert: insert into bss_pallet_number ( id, pallet_no, barcode, storage_period, classification, inbound_date, wh_cd, zone_cd, loc_cd, memo1, memo2, printed_flg, delete_flg, create_time, create_by, create_pg_id, update_time, update_by, update_pg_id, version ) values ( #{id}, #{palletNo}, #{barcode}, #{storagePeriod}, #{classification}, #{inboundDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{whCd}, #{zoneCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{locCd}, #{memo1}, #{memo2}, #{printedFlg}, #{deleteFlg}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{createPgId}, #{updateTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updatePgId}, #{version} )
mapper.update: update bss_pallet_number set storage_period = #{storagePeriod}, classification = #{classification}, inbound_date = #{inboundDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, wh_cd = #{whCd}, zone_cd = #{zoneCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, loc_cd = #{locCd}, memo1 = #{memo1}, memo2 = #{memo2}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_pg_id = #{updatePgId}, version = version + 1 where pallet_no = #{palletNo} and version = #{version}

update bss_pallet_number set printed_flg = #{printedFlg}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_pg_id = #{updatePgId}, version = version + 1 where pallet_no = #{palletNo} and delete_flg = '0' and printed_flg <> #{printedFlg}
update bss_pallet_number set delete_flg = '1', update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_pg_id = #{updatePgId}, version = version + 1 where pallet_no = #{palletNo}
mapper.insert: insert into bss_pallet_number_detail ( id, pallet_no, item_code, item_name, product_group, arrangement_no, storage_qty, storage_capacity, storage_type, usable_flag, remarks, delete_flg, create_time, create_by, create_pg_id, update_time, update_by, update_pg_id, version ) values ( #{id}, #{palletNo}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{productGroup,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{arrangementNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{storageQty}, #{storageCapacity,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{storageType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{usableFlag}, #{remarks,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deleteFlg}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{createPgId}, #{updateTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updatePgId}, #{version} )
